parameters.name: num_products
parameters.description: Number of products in the planning set

parameters.name: num_machines
parameters.description: Number of machines in the planning set

parameters.name: num_periods
parameters.description: Number of planning periods in the horizon

parameters.name: processing_time
parameters.description: Processing time required on machine m for product p per standardized lot produced

parameters.name: machine_capacity
parameters.description: Available capacity of machine m in period t

parameters.name: initial_inventory
parameters.description: Initial inventory for each product p

parameters.name: demand
parameters.description: Demand for each product p in each period t

variables.name: production_quantity
variables.description: Production quantity of product p in period t measured in standardized lots

variables.name: ending_inventory
variables.description: Inventory of product p at the end of period t

variables.name: objective_value
variables.description: Total ending inventory at the end of the planning horizon

constraints.name: production_continuity
constraints.description: Production quantity is continuous and may be fractional

constraints.name: inventory_nonnegativity
constraints.description: Ending inventory must never be negative for any product and period

constraints.name: machine_capacity_limit
constraints.description: Production in each period must not exceed available machine capacity on each machine

constraints.name: demand_fulfillment
constraints.description: Demand for each product and period must be satisfied by beginning inventory plus current-period production, leaving nonnegative ending inventory.
constraints.formula:
I_{p,t} = I0_p + \sum_{\tau=1}^{t} x_{p,\tau} - \sum_{\tau=1}^{t} D_{p,\tau} \quad \forall p=1,\dots,P,\; t=1,
\dots,T

constraints.name: inventory_carryover
constraints.description: Ending inventory is defined period by period through cumulative balance with demand satisfaction and carryover.
constraints.formula: I_{p,t} = I0_p + \sum_{\tau=1}^{t} x_{p,\tau} - \sum_{\tau=1}^{t} D_{p,\tau} \quad \forall p=1,\dots,P,\; t=1,\dots,T

constraints.name: nonnegative_data
constraints.description: Input quantities such as processing times, capacities, initial inventory, and demand must be nonnegative

constraints.name: inventory_balance
constraints.description: Inventory evolves by beginning inventory plus production minus demand in each period, ensuring demand is met and inventory carries forward correctly.
constraints.formula: I_{p,t} = I0_p + \sum_{\tau=1}^{t} x_{p,\tau} - \sum_{\tau=1}^{t} D_{p,\tau} \quad \forall p=1,\dots,P,\; t=1,\dots,T

objectives.name: maximize_total_ending_inventory
objectives.description: Maximize the total ending inventory at the end of the planning horizon across all products

final_objective.description: Maximize the total ending inventory at the end of the planning horizon across all products using the final-period inventory variables directly.
